summary: GMEX Robotics Corp (acquirer) filed a Form 6-K reporting a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire a 30% equity stake in Alpha Meta AI Pte. Ltd. (issuer), the owner of MediaMeta. The reference equity valuation is US$8.4 million, implying an initial purchase price of US$2.52 million, payable 60% cash and 40% in GMEX Class A ordinary shares. Consideration subject to downward adjustment based on due diligence. 10% of consideration escrowed. Irrevocable option within 24 months post-close to acquire controlling interest. Board recommendation: not specified. No named advisor. Mechanics include make-good revenue provisions (target >US$52.6 million over 5 years) and an exclusive technology license agreement. Closing conditions not detailed. What to watch: risk-arb hinges on valuation adjustment, due diligence outcomes, and option exercise.
